name: Dana Lange / Learn Mah Jongg
notes: Own site: "American Mah Jongg is the game everyone loves. Learning to play it should be nothing but fun." Offers Beginner (9 hrs), Beyond Beginner (9 hrs) and a 3-hour New Card Class when the National Mah Jongg League releases its annual card. Classes can be arranged at clubs, businesses or as private lessons. Specific upcoming class dates not found on the home page.
